name: Calendar (reference styling)
description: Calendar widget that styles events from a Reference (foreign key) column instead of a Choice/ChoiceList column. Each event's colors and font are taken from the referenced category row.

columns.name: category
columns.title: Category
columns.description: foreign key to a table whose row carries the event style (colors, font)

columns.name: background
columns.title: Background
columns.description: per-event CSS background / shade (e.g. a gradient); overrides the category

columns.name: image
columns.title: Image URL
columns.description: per-event image URL shown as the event background; overrides the category
